51: And similarly, with regard to monetary matters - this [entire] discussion of Rava's, in which we derive [the law of] betrothal from the law of a guarantor and from the law of a Canaanite slave -- it is likewise applicable to the matter of monetary transactions. If one sold a field to another, and said to him, "give the money to so-and-so and my field is sold to you" -- it is [indeed] thereby acquired, from the law of a guarantor. [If he said:] "Here is 100 dinars, and your field shall be sold to so-and-so" -- that so-and-so acquires  it, from the law of a slave. [If he said:] "Give 100 dinars to so-and-so, and my field shall be sold to him" -- he thereby acquires it, from the laws of both of them.
